item.title: Brandon King's 81 not out guides West Indies to 1-0 series lead against Bangladesh
item.description: West Indies defeated Bangladesh by eight wickets in the first Test after chasing down a target of 170 runs on Saturday. Opener Brandon King led the charge with an unbeaten 81 off 115 balls, hitting 10 fours and a six. Kavem Hodge supported him with an unbeaten 31 as West Indies comfortably secured a 1-0 lead in the two-match series. West Indies' spinners played a major role in the win, bowling Bangladesh out for just 142 in their second innings. Captain Roston Chase picked up five wickets for 36 runs, while Jomel Warrican claimed four for 63. Warrican had also taken five wickets in Bangladesh's first innings. Bangladesh resumed Day 4 at 79 for six but managed only 63 more runs. Nayeem Hasan top-scored with 52, recording his maiden Test half-century, but Chase eventually dismissed him to complete his five-wicket haul. King and Campbell lead the chase Chasing 170 on a difficult pitch, West Indies openers Brandon King and John Campbell chose to attack rather than defend against Bangladesh's spinners. The pair added 112 runs for the first wicket, putting their team in a strong position. King brought up his sixth Test half-century, while Campbell scored 49 after making 54 in the first innings. Shoriful Islam dismissed Campbell with a swinging delivery, while Hasan Mahmud removed Tagenarine Chanderpaul for one. However, Bangladesh could not create further pressure as King and Hodge added an unbeaten 50-run partnership to finish the chaseEarlier, Bangladesh scored 272 in their first innings before West Indies replied with 245. The second Test will be played in Sylhet next week, with Bangladesh looking to level the series.

item.title: Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli live results, updates, highlights from 2026 boxing fight
item.description: Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli live results, updates, highlights from 2026 boxing fight originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Saul 'Canelo' Alvarez attempts to reclaim a portion of the world super middleweight title when he returns to action on Halloween to challenge Christian Mbilli for the WBC's 168-pound belt. The fight is Canelo’s (63-3-2) second in Saudi Arabia, part of a deal with Riyadh Season. He last fought a year ago, where he lost his undisputed 12-stone title to fellow modern great Terence Crawford. Despite the time off, Canelo didn’t want to take an easy fight back. The multi-division champion aims to have gold around his waist again by beating the dangerous Mbilli. "I don’t believe in shortcuts. That’s why I go straight to the champion," Canelo said via Boxing Scene . "I already have that experience. I’ve been a champion many years, and I hope to be a champion again. I want to face the best, and he’s a champion, that’s it." Mbilli (29-0-1) has 23 knockout wins and took out Maciej Sulecki to become the interim champion. Promoted after Crawford relinquished the belt, his last fight was a draw. Mbilli is ready to prove he’s worthy of being champion against Canelo. "I’m ready to shock the world," said Mbilli. "I have a big respect for Canelo and all his career. I want to congratulate him for this, but Saturday will be a different story. I’m coming for the win." The Sporting News will provide analysis and highlights from the Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli fight card and round-by-round coverage of the main event. item.title: Returning Estevao brings X-factor to strikerless Chelsea
item.description: Estevao had two goals ruled out for offside against Manchester United [Getty Images] Estevao Willian had not started a Premier League match this season before his electric display against Manchester United on Saturday. The 19-year-old winger was an unused substitute for the midweek penalty shootout defeat by Liverpool but was still serenaded with chants from away fans at Anfield. Three days later, after questions had been raised about the Brazil international's lack of opportunities, Chelsea supporters made their feelings clear. Early on against United at Stamford Bridge, supporters chanted "Steve-o", their tongue-in-cheek nickname for the £38m signing from Palmeiras. This time he was on the field, making things happen in a team that lacked a recognised striker, and the loud backing from the stands appeared justified. Estevao had an early goal ruled out for offside before another fine near-post finish in the second half was disallowed - a marginal decision. At the end of his 86-minute display in the Blues' 2-0 victory, Estevao received a standing ovation from the home crowd and a hug from Chelsea head coach Xabi Alonso. He had six shots, the joint-most by a Chelsea player in a Premier League match this season, along with a host of other impressive attacking contributions. He recorded 12 touches in the opposition penalty area, created three chances, delivered eight crosses and completed five dribbles - all either the most or joint-most by a Chelsea player in Saturday's match. Estevao's limited recent involvement remains curious. Before this, he had made only one start this season, against League One side Luton Town in the Carabao Cup in September. It has led to speculation in the Brazilian media that he is unhappy or pushing for a move. However, both publicly and privately, sources at Chelsea and those close to Estevao have suggested no signs of discontent. There has been widespread praise for his professionalism behind the scenes and a feeling that he has been unfortunate, not least with the form of Morgan Rogers, Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro, which has limited his opportunities. Chelsea's tendency to score first or take early leads has also meant more defensive options have often been chosen from the bench. There was talk before Saturday's match that Alonso was keeping his plans to start Estevao against Manchester United under wraps, having faced questions from the media about the winger in the build-up. He confirmed after the victory that the decision had already been made. In fact, it was made in the aftermath of last weekend's home defeat by Tottenham. "We spoke after Tottenham and he knew that he was going to be playing tonight, today," Alonso said. "He has had the best response to show that he deserves more, that he was prepared, and that's what you want from a football player, so I'm very happy for him. "He deserved to enjoy his game. He had a good connection with the crowd. He was really close to scoring that goal. At the end he fought real

item.title: Martinez's 'inexplicable' 83 seconds cost Man Utd and Carrick
item.description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez is shown a red card by referee Peter Bankes during the 2-0 defeat at Chelsea [Getty Images] Lisandro Martinez made his way to the tunnel slowly and silently. The whistles and jeers of the Chelsea fans were ringing in his ears. Manchester United coach Jonny Evans had a brief word, but Martinez didn't pay any attention. As a player, Martinez has scaled the heights. Part of the Argentina squad that won the World Cup in 2022 and reached the final last summer. But at Stamford Bridge, when Michael Carrick needed his side to step up and his senior players to set an example, Martinez did the very opposite. Eighteen days after Martinez called out United's summer recruitment, he suffered the kind of meltdown that would have left most United fans questioning whether that poor recruitment involved not turfing the 28-year-old out of Old Trafford. The former Ajax defender had been part of a much improved United performance at Stamford Bridge and Carrick's team should have been ahead at half-time. Even when Morgan Rogers gave Chelsea a second-half lead, they had done enough for the visiting fans to believe a comeback was possible. Instead, in the space one minute and 23 seconds, Martinez committed two fouls that left Carrick's side 2-0 down and playing with 10 men - with Chelsea subsequently cruising to victory . However this woeful period unfolds, it is unlikely Martinez's recklessness will be forgotten. Martinez 'rightly sent off' Martinez was sent off with 27 minutes of normal time remaining [Getty Images] It was noticeable that Carrick did not look at Martinez as he made his way off the pitch. He was more concentrated on trying to come up with a plan with his assistant Steve Holland to get through the rest of the game. Asked afterwards if he felt let down by Martinez, Carrick said he had not had a chance to view the incident again. "I've not seen it back, so I don't know if it was or not" adding "it's a big moment in the game". Carrick continued: "The second goal and losing a man at that stage had a big influence on it, for sure." For context, Martinez, already on a booking, chose the moment Estevao swung over the corner to try and block off Wesley Fofana at the far post. In the process, Martinez raised his elbow and caught the defender in the face. The incident was missed in real time but video assistant referee (VAR) James Bell advised referee Peter Bankes to go to the screen and the obvious conclusion was reached. World Cup final official Darren Cann called Martinez's actions "inexplicable". "He jumped into him, making no attempt to play the ball and not even looking at the ball as it came in from the corner," Cann told BBC Sport. "Martinez was rightly sent off for two bookable offences, as well as conceding a needless penalty for the reckless challenge on Fofana." Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to heap further pressure on Carrick Martinez at 'scene of crime too often' United avoided the ignominy of a third succe

item.title: Deliver your ward or… – Gombe APC gov candidate tells supporters
item.description: By John Alechenu, ABUJA The All Progressives Congress, APC, governorship candidate in Gombe State, Dr. Jamil Gwamna, has challenged party members and supporters to prove their political worth at the grassroots. Gwamna launched what he described as ‘Operation Deliver Your Ward’, calling on supporters to secure victory for the party from their polling units and wards. He spoke during activities marking Gombe State’s 30th anniversary celebration. According to him, the true measure of political strength and influence lies not in rhetoric, but in the ability to mobilise grassroots support, beginning from one’s polling unit. He said he would hold in the highest regard those political associates who demonstrate commitment by winning their polling units and delivering their wards. Gwamna said, “The true test is at the polling unit. We will hold in highest regard those who deliver their wards. We will continue to reach every nook and cranny of Gombe State to seek support and votes.” The APC candidate called on party members to put aside their differences, close ranks and work together as a united force, likening the strength of the party to the strands of a broom bound together. He urged voluntary organisations, support groups, youths, women and other APC stakeholders to step up grassroots engagement, strengthen party structures and mobilise support for victory at all levels. Gwamna also reaffirmed his commitment to providing purposeful and responsible leadership, assuring the people of Gombe State that if entrusted with the mandate, he would govern with justice, honesty and accountability. item.title: What Warriors’ Stephen Curry said about epic ankle-breaker vs. Lakers’ Luka Doncic
item.description: Credit: David Gonzales-Imagn Images What Warriors’ Stephen Curry said about epic ankle-breaker vs. Lakers’ Luka Doncic appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Golden State Warriors superstar Stephen Curry left Luka Doncic on the floor with a spectacular ankle-breaker against the Los Angeles Lakers. The highlight quickly attracted attention, but Curry’s reaction afterward made the moment even more entertaining. The Warriors guard admitted he was simply looking for enough room to get his shot off. Instead, he created far more separation than he anticipated, leaving Doncic scrambling to recover. “I was just trying to get a little bit of space. I didn’t expect it to get that nasty,” Curry said in a postgame interview shared on X. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Curry also acknowledged how unusually wide open he found himself after the move. “I haven’t been that open in a long time,” he added. The sequence showcased the ball-handling skills that have helped define Curry’s career. With a sudden change of direction, the two-time MVP created enough separation to send Doncic to the hardwood. What made the moment especially memorable was Curry’s apparent surprise at the result. Rather than describing the play as intentional humiliation, he framed it as a routine attempt to create shooting space. The highlight also caught the attention of teammate De’Anthony Melton, who admitted he missed the actual move . Melton said he looked back and suddenly saw Doncic on the floor, leaving him eager to watch the replay. Curry’s reaction gave a different perspective on a play that immediately became a talking point among basketball fans. His ability to manufacture space against elite defenders remains one of his most dangerous weapons. For Doncic, it was an unfortunate appearance in another Curry highlight, while the Warriors star seemed almost as surprised as everyone watching. item.title: The Valkyries’ Game 7 ‘win or die’ moment has arrived — Can they meet the spotlight?
item.description: The Valkyries’ Game 7 ‘win or die’ moment has arrived — Can they meet the spotlight? appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . More often than not, the Golden State Valkyries have been able to speak their dreams into reality. “Empty the tank,” “Control what we can control,” “Play our brand of basketball”; whenever the Valkyries have had to dig deep and draw on their unparalleled collective spirit to meet the moment, they have, manifesting victory time and time again. Willpower, fight, heart — that’s been their superpower all season long, a superpower few have been able to overcome on their magical run to the precipice of a WNBA championship. But a new moment shines a new spotlight for the Valkyries to step into. A Game 7, in Ballhalla, in front of 18,000 die-hard fans dressed in violet, for all the marbles, for golden glory. And with this gigantic moment, new words have been uttered: “Win or die.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “This is the finals, right?” Natalie Nakase asked rhetorically after Golden State’s 80-69 loss to the Atlanta Dream in Game 6 , squandering what she had described as a “great f—ing opportunity” in front of them. “These are win or die. This is do or die. This is it.” A very Nakase-esque way of cutting through the fluff of what’s at stake. It’s simple, really. The Valkyries stand four quarters from proving every single doubter, every single detractor, wrong about what they thought they were capable of. The ultimate “nobody believed in us” run. They stand one win away from upending the long-laid, untouched calculus of the WNBA– an expansion franchise winning a title with a ragtag group of castoffs led by an unappreciated, untraditional ace in Gabby Williams and commanded by an undeniable coaching talent in Nakase. They stand 40 minutes away from their hoop dreams, dreams they’ve had since they picked up a basketball and dreams they forged since coming together as a team that loves each other like family. And it’s all on the line. Because the Dream are threatening to kill the Valkyries’ dreams. Angel Reese awaits to stamp out their fire, and talk crazy while she does it. And Atlanta looks to prove they were the team of destiny, and that the Valkyries were one last dragon for them to slay before they reached the mountaintop. Golden State’s maxims, their philosophies, their identity, their collective, as strong as they are, face hard truths should Atlanta prevail. Because while winning makes everything eternal, losing turns everything mortal. It’s as they’ve said. It is win or die. And there’s no consolation prize for death. item.description: BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA - OCTOBER 14: Will Wade head coach of the LSU Tigers reacts during the second half of an exhibition game against the UCF Knights at Pete Maravich Assembly Center on October 14, 2026 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. item.title: Robyn Choi’s Surge Makes Her A Genuine LPGA Title Threat
item.description: May 31, 2018; Shoal Creek, AL, USA; Robyn Choi putts on the second green during the first round of the U.S. Women's Open Championship golf tournament at Shoal Creek. Mandatory Credit: John David Mercer-USA TODAY Sports Robyn Choi is finally within striking distance of a long-awaited LPGA Tour title, and the path looks clearer than it has in years. The Australian fired a six-under-par 66 on Saturday to sit tied for fourth place at the Maybank Championship in Malaysia. She trails the leader by just four shots, a margin that feels manageable on a course where scores are dropping fast. This isn’t just a good round; it is a genuine shot at her maiden victory. Choi’s round included eight birdies, a display of aggression that has been missing from her game for too long. According to Australian Golf Digest , she has managed only two top-10 results since her rookie season in 2019. That drought ends this weekend if she can keep her foot on the gas. The field is tough, but the gap is small enough to close with a few more hot holes. The Japanese Dominance Choi faces a massive hurdle in defending champion Miyu Yamashita. The Japanese star shot a 67 on Saturday to reach 18 under and hold a two-shot lead. Yamashita is the 2025 Women’s British Open winner and is hunting back-to-back wins in Kuala Lumpur. Australian Golf Digest noted she remains on track for consecutive triumphs, which adds serious pressure to the field. Beating a player on a hot streak is hard, but Choi has the numbers to make it happen. The Japanese presence is strong all around. Yuri Yoshida won last week in South Korea, marking the fourth win for a Japanese player this season. That momentum shifts the odds, but it does not seal the deal. Choi is right there, tied with Thai amateur Marisa Tojai, who also shot a 65. The competition is fierce, but the door is open. Aussie Contingent and the Cut Choi is not the only Australian making waves. Karis Davidson sits tied for 18th at nine under after a 70, while Cassie Porter is a shot further back. Hannah Green posted a 66 to climb to five under. According to the report, these players are all still in the hunt, but Choi has the clear momentum. The pressure is on to convert this chance into a win. A 63, the round of the day, put China’s Yan Liu in a tie for second place. That score includes an eagle and nine birdies, showing just how low the bar is set. If Choi can match that kind of scoring, she will be in the mix on Sunday. The leaderboard is tight, and every shot counts . The next round will define the tournament. The LPGA’s Asian swing is set to end next week with the Toto Japan Classic.

item.title: Cardiff stun Ebbw Vale with dramatic comeback win
item.description: Cardiff have won seven of their eight Super Rygbi Cymru Trophy matches this season [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Cardiff came from 15 points behind to earn a dramatic 32-29 victory over Ebbw Vale and move to the top of the Super Rygbi Cymru Trophy table. Ryan Jenkins scored a hat-trick for the visitors, with Thomas Howard adding seven points from the tee as the away side raced into a 22-7 lead. Dewi Cross, Ethan Coombes, Alfie Prygodzicz, Ben Fry and Joe Goodchild all crossed the whitewash for the hosts, although Ebbw Vale made it a level game with a Jonathan Evans try. But Rhys Cummings kicked a last-gasp penalty as the capital side clinched an incredible comeback win, with the Gwent side having to settle for two losing bonus points. Rygbi Gogledd Cymru (RGC) made it back-to-back wins with an emphatic 49-19 victory over strugglers Pontypool in north Wales. The hosts ran in seven tries - with Sam Jones scoring a brace and Gareth Parry, Dion Jones, Delwyn Jones, Osian Burt and Tudur Jones all touching down to seal third win of the campaign and rise to fifth. Llandovery came from behind to earn a fourth success of the season, beating bottom side Aberavon 27-17. On Friday night, Newport held on for a hard-fought 21-19 win at Carmarthen Quins. Joe Salter, Joshua Skinner and Gethyn Cannon all touched down for the visitors, who saw Llew O'Brien add three conversions. Lewys Mellin, Lewis Morgan and Thomas Williams scored tries for the hosts, although a missed conversion proved crucial as they suffered a narrow defeat. Elsewhere, Swansea sealed back-to-back wins as they earned an impressive 32-19 bonus-point victory over Bridgend at St Helen's.

item.title: Mississippi State considering major QB change vs. Texas amid Kamario Taylor injury
item.description: Jeff Blake-Imagn Images Mississippi State considering major QB change vs. Texas amid Kamario Taylor injury appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Mississippi State Bulldogs will be without quarterback Kamario Taylor for the remainder of the season due to toe surgery. They started Parker Puckett for two games after Taylor’s injury, but the freshman’s performance wasn’t up to par. So now, Mississippi State head coach Jeff Lebby is set to change things up for their big game against Texas . “It’s been trending toward Mississippi State starting AJ Swann at quarterback today against No. 11 Texas, sources tell CBSSports,” Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reported on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Swann had been the third-string QB behind Kamario Taylor, who is now out for the season, and Parker Puckett, who was previously Taylor’s backup. Before Mississippi State, Swann played at Vanderbilt, LSU and App State.” Puckett did not perform well in either of his starts against LSU and Oklahoma. He combined for just 278 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions in those two games, both of which the Bulldogs lost. Swann now looks set to take over for the Bulldogs against the Longhorns. The senior played for Appalachian State last season, where he threw for 1,495 yards with 10 touchdowns and eight interceptions. Luckily for him, he will not be facing Texas’ star edge rusher, Colin Simmons, who’s been ruled out with a high ankle sprain . With this change, Lebby will be hoping Swann can jumpstart a passing game that has stagnated after Taylor went out. Top wide receiver Anthony Evans III, in particular, has seen his production plummet under Puckett. After four 110+ receiving yard games in five, including 12 catches for 166 yards and two touchdowns against Alabama, Evans has had just 73 total receiving yards with no touchdowns in Puckett’s two starts. item.title: Why Broncos RB J.K. Dobbins has become a name to watch for NFL trade deadline
item.description: Why Broncos RB J.K. Dobbins has become a name to watch for NFL trade deadline originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Denver Broncos are a team likely to be in the buyer's market at the 2026 NFL trade deadline. There are a few areas worth looking at for this Broncos squad, including on defense. But the biggest need for this team might come at running back. While their current options haven't been horrible, if this team wants to take a huge leap, landing a superstar RB would be a huge help in getting past the Kansas City Chiefs . But the Broncos might not only add to their RB room, but they could also look to trade J.K. Dobbins. Why? According to The Athletic's Jonathan Jones , if the Broncos add a star RB in a trade, then Dobbins could become expendable and be a trade candidate. Why Broncos could trade J.K. Dobbins away before NFL deadline "If the Denver Broncos were to land a new running back, that would make J.K. Dobbins expendable," Jones reports. "Hard to see him leaving Denver if the team doesn't acquire a runner in the next week and a half, though." Denver is going to be in the market for Taylor, the star Colts running back, leading up to the trade deadline. Plenty of other teams are likely involved as well, but if the Broncos win the bidding war, Dobbins could be on the move. Jonah Coleman is a rookie running back and isn't going anywhere. RJ Harvey, while he just got banged up, has been a solid runner and receiver when given the opportunity. If the Broncos land Taylor, or another star running back like Tony Pollard or even Saquon Barkley, then trading Dobbins would make some sense. MORE : NFL insiders reveal four landing spots for Colts ’ Jonathan Taylor Nothing is saying the Broncos have to trade Dobbins if they add a star RB like Taylor, but it would make sense to try and recoup some value for him in a trade this Fall if they no longer need him as a lead back. Obviously, if the Broncos stand pat at the trade deadline at running back, Dobbins will be sticking in Denver. But if they win the sweepstakes for a star RB, Broncos fans shouldn't rule out seeing Dobbins on the move as well. This could be a very interesting trade deadline for the Denver backfield, as it could look a lot different after the November 10 trade deadline than it does heading into Week 8. item.title: Lakers reportedly scouting Pelicans' elite athletic duo for potential roster-boosting trade
item.description: Lakers reportedly scouting Pelicans' elite athletic duo for potential roster-boosting trade originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Los Angeles Lakers spent the entire offseason building around Luka Doncic, who is now the face of the franchise following LeBron James' departure for the Philadelphia 76ers . LA put together an almost entirely new starting lineup compared to last season. However, the Lakers are still looking to add another player or two, specifically a center or someone who can provide more size. “The Lakers are still monitoring the market for big men, team sources told The Athletic," The Athletic's Dan Woike reported. "They traded for Walker Kessler and signed Kevon Looney to play center, and Mamukelashvili can play the position, too. The team could address the position either by trade or signing, like with potentially adding Thybulle. The roster is currently at full capacity." Another major point of emphasis this offseason was improving the team's defense. Most of the Lakers' additions were aimed at strengthening that side of the ball. “The Lakers finished 20th in defensive rating last season. This season, they believe Kessler, as well as the wings they collected, including Quentin Grimes, Ziaire Williams, Matisse Thybulle and Collin Sexton, can provide active, disruptive on-ball pressure and length on the perimeter," SI's Ricardo Sandoval wrote. Even after those additions, the Lakers are still looking for more defensive help around the league. NBA insider Brett Siegel identified LA as one of the teams scouting New Orleans Pelicans players Trey Murphy III and Herb Jones. “Multiple teams are monitoring the situation surrounding both Jones and Trey Murphy III. Among those mentioned by sources or seen in an arena are the Houston Rockets , Los Angeles Lakers, Chicago Bulls, Washington Wizards , Golden State Warriors , Oklahoma City Thunder , San Antonio Spurs , Detroit Pistons , and Memphis Grizzlies ,” Siegel wrote. Both Murphy and Jones would bring defensive value, which is something the Lakers are still looking to add. However, Murphy could provide an additional boost offensively, as he is a better shooter than Jones. LA is clearly interested in making a deal, but it will ultimately come down to which player the team values more, as it likely doesn't have enough draft capital to acquire both. Murphy appears to be the more logical trade target for the Lakers, and adding him could help the team in several ways if a deal eventually comes together. item.title: Füllkrug extends scoring streak as Bremen climb to fifth after beating Hoffenheim
item.description: Füllkrug extends scoring streak as Bremen climb to fifth after beating Hoffenheim Second-half goals from returnees Niclas Füllkrug and Eren Dinkci secured a home win for Werder Bremen against TSG Hoffenheim. With their first back-to-back victory, the hosts climbed to fifth in the standings. Daniel Thioune had to make an early substitution as Mitchell Weiser suffered another setback after making his return from a long-term injury. To no one's surprise, Niclas Füllkrug had Bremen's first real chance before Marco Grüll's header narrowly missed the target. Hoffenheim's best chance of the first-half came in the 45th minute when Amos Pieper cleared Adam Hložek's header from the goal line. The Czechia international was also instrumental in Hoffenheim's first chance after the break, but Youri Regeer denied Fisnik Asllani. Füllkrug started the second-half strongly as Oliver Baumann had to make a decent save from his powerful effort minutes before he got his customary goal. The 33-year-old striker won a physical tussle against Hoffenheim's defense before firing an unstoppable shot for his ninth goal of the season. Asllani had a couple of half chances to bring back Hoffenheim into the game, but Bremen dominated the proceedings after their goal. And Eren Dinkci sealed the win for the hosts eight minutes from time with a composed finish after Grüll's league-high sixth assist of the season. Bremen rose to fifth place after winning back-to-back games in Bundesliga for the first time this season. Füllkrug extended his scoring run to eight games in all competitions. Meanwhile, Hoffenheim suffered back-to-back defeats in the cup and Bundesliga.

Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Indiana football team hopes to keep the wins coming on Saturday, with a game against Minnesota. Hoosiers head coach Curt Cignetti is revealing more about his quarterback, Josh Hoover. Hoover is getting compared to Indiana’s last quarterback, Fernando Mendoza. Cignetti is explaining what he sees as the difference between the two quarterbacks. “I think Fernando may have had a few more weapons to work with, in terms of depth and numbers,” Cignetti said on ESPN Saturday to Kirk Herbstreit. “We have weapons certainly too, but we have some youth in some spots.” Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) I asked Coach Cignetti what sets Josh Hoover apart from Fernando Mendoza and last season’s national championship team 🏈⬇️ pic.twitter.com/Z4DOLGxXSe — Kirk Herbstreit (@KirkHerbstreit) October 31, 2026 Hoover will likely always be compared to Mendoza, as he is Mendoza’s successor. In 2025, Mendoza led Indiana to a national championship under Cignetti. This season, Indiana is 7-1 on the campaign . Hoover has been incredible at protecting the football. He has 18 touchdown passes to just one interception on the campaign. The quarterback also has 1,741 passing yards. “I look for him to have a really good game today,” Cignetti said of Hoover. Hoover transferred to Indiana after playing several years at TCU. In both 2024 and 2025, Hoover threw for more than 3,000 passing yards for the Horned Frogs. Indiana is hoping to once again reach the College Football Playoff under Cignetti. The Hoosiers are in great position to do just that. The team’s lone loss this year is to Ohio State. Indiana enters Saturday’s game with just one loss since the 2024 campaign. The Hoosiers went undefeated in 2025. Indiana fans hope that Cignetti’s team can run the table and reach the Big Ten title game once again this year. Indiana and Minnesota play Saturday at 3:30 ET. Minnesota enters the game with a 5-2 record. item.title: High-flying Hertha Berlin win again
item.description: High-flying Hertha Berlin win again 2. Bundesliga leaders Hertha Berlin moved nine points clear of second-placed Wolfsburg after their resounding 3-0 victory over Kaiserslautern, who had conceded just four goals in nine games before their Matchday 10 clash. Sebastian Grønning struck either side of the break to double his tally for the campaign before Oluwaseun Adewumi – on loan from Championship side Burnley – completed the rout on the hour. It means that the Old Lady are now unbeaten in their ten 2. Bundesliga fixtures (nine wins, one draw) this season as they look to secure a return to Germany’s top flight following their relegation in May 2023. Speaking after Saturday’s win, head coach Stefan Leitl laded his team’s performance. “It was an incredibly intense match with some really tough challenges,” he explained. “We gradually found our rhythm. From the second goal onwards, we completely dominated the game. “Overall, we put on a fantastic away performance, never let up, and remained focused throughout. A huge compliment to my team for ending the midweek fixture so positively.” GGFN | Daniel Pinder

item.title: Indiana fans express faith in Josh Hoover ahead of Minnesota matchup
item.description: PISCATAWAY, NEW JERSEY - OCTOBER 3: Josh Hoover #10 of the Indiana Hoosiers looks on ahead of the game against the Rutgers Scarlet Knights at SHI Stadium on October 03, 2026 in Piscataway, New Jersey. (Photo by Caleb Bowlin/Getty Images) | Getty Images Indiana football is coming off of a weird stretch of three games coming into the matchup against Minnesota on Saturday afternoon in Bloomington. The Hoosier offense ran into issues against Nebraska, with the running game looking less than stellar against the Cornhuskers, only for similar issues to take root in the next matchup against Ohio State. Against Ohio State, Indiana’s passing game largely kept it in the game but quarterback Josh Hoover completed just 50% of his attempts through the air. It wasn’t all Hoover’s fault, necessarily. Indiana’s dependence on the pass allowed Ohio State to defend it differently. On top of that, he suffered an injury to his throwing arm in the second half that left him wincing after throws. Hoover continued playing through that injury against Michigan, completing just 44.4% of his passes and attempting just one in the second half. He ended up saving the day through the air, completing a chunk pass to tight end Brock Schott in overtime to set up the game-winning go-ahead touchdown for himself, rushing into the endzone for the score. He just wasn’t at 100%. Indiana’s staff even had light conversations about inserting backup quarterback Grant Wilson in lieu of Hoover, but stuck with their starter. With this in mind, we surveyed Indiana fans this week to see if they’d agree with starting Wilson against Minnesota should Hoover not be back at 100%. Hoosier fans responded by favoring Hoover: Just 47% of fans who responded viewed starting Wilson as the right move. It’s a decently slim margin, but Hoosier fans still see Hoover as the solution to what ails the offense. Indiana has the potential in it to win by multiple scores today, sitting as a 20-point favorite as of this afternoon according to FanDuel Sportsbook . Minnesota has struggled against the run, but its reasonable to believe that Indiana will flex the pass should its backs prove productive on the ground. Join the conversation! item.title: Green Bay Packers: Jordan Love is having an MVP-caliber season despite horrid offensive deficiencies
item.description: The Green Bay Packers are 5-3 on the season following their 27-19 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Thursday Night Football. While they remain out of first place in the NFC North, they are at least keeping pace with the rest of the division and are currently a part of the convoluted playoff picture. For much of the year so far, it has been Green Bay’s defense that has shone the brightest. Playing without star pass rusher Micah Parsons, who is expected to return in Week 12 on Thanksgiving, the Packers defensive unit leads the NFL in both sacks and takeaways (as of this writing). What many outside of Green Bay are now starting to realize after watching their latest Prime Time game is that Jordan Love , too, is a huge reason for the Packers success up to this point in the season. Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love should be an MVP candidate Oct 25, 2026; Detroit, Michigan, USA; Green Bay Packers quarterback Jordan Love (10) looks to pass during the first quarter against the Detroit Lions at Ford Field. Mandatory Credit: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images While the rest of the NFL has yet to play their Week Eight games, a look at Love’s numbers so far in 2026 are indications that he will end up among the league leaders in the most important offensive categories by the end of the season. Currently, Love leads the league in passing yards (2,246), passing touchdowns (16), attempts (312), and completions (196). His 61.5% completion percentage looks, well, less than ideal. However, it should be noted that his pass catchers lead the league in drops with 18. Matthew Golden, who is otherwise having a stellar season, leads the NFL with eight. If just half of those team drops had been caught, Love’s completion percentage would be 64.8%. If they were all caught, it would be 67.7%, which would rank among the top-ten in the league. In addition to the woeful drops by his receivers, Love has had the worst protection in the league. Green Bay’s offensive line is giving him just 2.48 seconds to throw, which ranks 35th among quarterbacks who have played in the NFL this season. Of course, the line’s woes are not limited to pass protection. The Packers run game ranks last in the league with 60.6 yards per game, meaning that Love shoulders the burden of virtually the entire offense. Through eight games, Love has accounted for 82% of Green Bay’s yards gained on offense in 2026. The defense has definitely helped the Packers win games, but the fact of the matter is that any lesser quarterback would not be able to produce on the level that Love is. His production should get him some MVP consideration by season’s end, but whether or not the Packers’ overall performance will get the attention of voters remains to be seen. If he is able to lead Green Bay back to the postseason despite all of the other struggles on offense, he should be the unquestioned MVP of the league. item.title: Michael Carrick tells Manchester United to 'keep moving forward' as Chelsea defeat leaves them facing the relegation zone
item.description: Chelsea FC v Manchester United - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Michael Carrick has urged Manchester United to "keep moving forward" after a 2-0 defeat by Chelsea at Stamford Bridge on Saturday left them in danger of slipping into the relegation zone. United created a flurry of first-half chances but failed to take any, before Morgan Rogers struck after the interval and Lisandro Martinez was sent off for a second yellow card. Carrick plays down relegation zone fears United came into the clash just one point above the drop zone , the Manchester Evening News reported, meaning they could be leapfrogged by the end of the day depending on results. "We have got to keep moving forward and winning games, simple as that," Carrick said of the prospect. "There's no words that I'm going to explain to you now that makes it any difference; it's not going to change it. We've got to move forward and win football matches, it's as simple as that." Asked whether there would be a stigma around dropping into the bottom three, he replied: "Not from me, no." Chelsea punish wasteful United at Stamford Bridge United started well and created a flurry of chances in the first half, but they were unable to convert them and Rogers struck for Chelsea in the 59th minute. It got worse when Martinez was shown a second yellow card after colliding with Wesley Fofana, and Cole Palmer's penalty beat Senne Lammens despite the goalkeeper getting a hand to it. "I think it was as good as we've played for some time, I think, in the first half," Carrick said in his press conference. "Yeah, but that's the way it goes," he added of his side's wastefulness. "That's the swings, and that's what you've got to deal with. Got to capitalise when things are going well and sums it up, you know, you get that when you're having a run like we are." Carrick unsure over Martinez sending-off Carrick felt his side had been a real threat before the break. "We looked dangerous, we looked fluid, we looked like a good team and, as I said, we looked really dangerous. Could, should have scored one or two, maybe three even with the chances and the spaces that we created, and then the game gets away from us," Carrick said. "Some decisions, I've not seen back, so I don't know if it was or not (a sending off). He's obviously gone to it, and the referee gave that decision, but it's a big moment in the game. The second half got away from us, which is something we've got to deal with, you know. "Sometimes you get setbacks in games and you've got to deal with that better, you know, from being in such a good place first half. The two halves of football probably couldn't be further apart in some ways." He added of the red card: "It was a major part of the game. The second goal and losing the man at that stage had a big influence on it, for sure, yeah." What next for Carrick and United? item.title: No. 17 GVSU men's basketball opens season by edging Harding
item.description: The No. 17 Grand Valley State men's basketball team defeated Harding 75-69 in the season opener Friday, Oct. 30, at the Midwest Tip-Off Classic in Wisconsin Dells. The Lakers begin the season 1-0, while Harding falls to 0-1. Marcus Gray II led the Lakers in scoring with a career high 18 points on 5-8 shooting from the field with four three-pointers. Gray II shot a perfect 4-4 from the free throw line. Austin Tory notched his first career double-double with a career high 15 points and 10 rebounds on 7-12 shooting from the field. Tory added three assists and one block in the win. Antaune Allen scored 11 points with two three-pointers and three assists, while Shamus Thompson added nine points and eight rebounds. More: Defending NCAA champion GVSU women's basketball gets career-high from Bisballe to dominate top-10 battle GVSU shot 46% from the field and 9-18 for 50% from behind the arc. Harding shot 46% from the field and 0-13 from three-point range. The Lakers dished out 14 assists and scored 30 points in the paint. GVSU forced the Bisons to commit 13 turnovers and scored 11 points off their turnovers. Harding outrebounded 38-34 and 13-10 in offensive rebounds. The Lakers never trailed at any point in the game and started the game on a 15-2 run through the first six minutes that included back-to-back three-pointers by Antaune Allen. GVSU extended the lead to 18 points at 23-5 with back-to-back triples by Marcus Gray II and Marshawn Cocroft with 12:00 minutes to play in the first half. Harding would go on a 10-0 run to cut the Laker lead to 23-15 with nine minutes left in the first. GVSU would respond with a 7-1 run to increase the lead back to 14 points at 30-16. Gray II. Would hit his second three of the half to give GVSU A 37-23 lead with under four minutes in the first half. Ezra Brown would knock down a pull-up midrange jumper to give the Lakers their largest lead of the game at 46-27 with over one minute remaining in the first. The Lakers would take a 46-29 lead into the break. In the second half, Harding would start on a 6-0 run that was stopped by a three-pointer by Tory to put GVSU up 49-35. Over the next four minutes, the Lakers would go on an 8-2 run to take a 57-39 lead with over 12 minutes to play in the game. Harding would go on a 19-10 run over the next nine minutes to pull within singles digits on 67-58 with just over three minutes remaining. The Bisons would cut the Laker lead to six at 69-63 after a converted and one. GVSU knock down free throws the rest of the way and Austin tory blocked a shot with seconds remaining to help secure the season opening win. This article originally appeared on The Holland Sentinel: No. 17 GVSU men's basketball opens season by edging Harding

item.title: Where To Watch USC vs. Ohio State: TV, Stream, and Game Time
item.description: Ohio State Buckeyes defensive lineman Robert Landers (67) tackles USC Trojans running back Ronald Jones II (25) during the third quarter of the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas on Dec. 29, 2017. [Adam Cairns / Dispatch] Saturday night belongs to college football, and the spotlight shines brightly on the clash between USC and Ohio State. Fans across the nation are tuning in to see if the Trojans can stop the Buckeyes, who are the consensus best team in the Big Ten. The game starts at 7:30 p.m. Eastern time, and you will want to be settled in before the first snap. According to Yahoo Sports , this matchup comes at a tough time for USC as they try to shake off last week’s rough loss. How to Catch the Action Live The game is a key test for both squads as they look to prove their worth early in the season. It is a big night for the sport, and missing it would be a shame for any true fan. The game kicks off at 7:30 p.m. ET on NBC and streams on Peacock. Can the Trojans Survive the Trenches? The biggest worry for USC is its running game, which was completely shut down against Wisconsin last week. The Buckeyes have a massive front line that will likely do the same thing again. The Trojans managed only –17 rushing yards against Wisconsin last week , which means they may struggle to move the ball on the ground. This has forced quarterback Jayden Maiava to carry the load and make big throws under pressure. Maiava was sacked five times and threw two interceptions in the last game, so he has to be perfect this time. The defense needs help too, especially from freshman Luke Wafle, who has been a force with multiple sacks in recent weeks. He’ll need to be at the top of his game if the Trojans want to keep this game competitive. The Trojans have the talent to compete, but they must play a clean game to stay close.

item.title: Rob Gronkowski urges Roger Goodell to sanction new ‘punishment’ after what he’s noticed
item.description: Photo by Paras Griffin/Getty Images The NFL have not shied away from handing out fines to players this season for a number of different trivial issues. There has been a lot of controversy after players like Kyle Juszczyk were heavily fined for a celebration mimicking him drinking from a can. More recently, Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams was fined for wearing a certain brand of cleats. Now, around halfway through the 2026 season, Rob Gronkowski is urging Roger Goodell and the NFL to start punishing some of their officials. There have been numerous poor refereeing performances which have seemingly gone unpunished and Gronkowski wants to see some action taken. Rob Gronkowski urges Roger Goodell to punish NFL referees Two officials were dropped just a matter of weeks ago following conduct issues during their respective games. However, Gronkowski believes there are also a number of decisions made by some officials that could warrant punishment from the league. “There are a lot of terrible pass interference calls. There are a lot of terrible rushing the passer calls, and it’s affecting the game. I don’t think the referees are doing that great of a job,” said Gronkowski. “I think it would be fair and square to put the referees on a pedestal as well and have punishment, just like any coach or any NFL player can be punished just like that.” Of course, the officials could not be fined to the same extent as the players, given the difference in salaries. Gronkowski does open up the conversation, though, as to whether the referees are held to a high enough standard by the league. It is clear just how frustrated Gronkowski has grown with some of the refereeing decisions. However, the frustration of the current players and coaches will only be even greater. item.title: What losing to Napoli could mean for Spalletti
item.description: What losing to Napoli could mean for Spalletti The shadow of Antonio Conte now looms large over Luciano Spalletti, and the game against Napoli could prove a turning point for the current Bianconeri manager. Spalletti is no longer smiling as much as he once did, as he understands that his situation is critical and results must improve for him to keep his job. Juventus have ordered their players into a retreat as they attempt to find a solution to their problems. If things do not change, the club will likely consider appointing a new manager, with Conte among the potential alternatives being discussed . Pressure Mounts on Spalletti Spalletti had two matches to ease the pressure following the home loss to Lazio. He secured a victory against Lecce, but then suffered defeat to Genoa, leaving his position increasingly uncertain. It will be difficult for Spalletti to turn the situation around, but as reported by Tuttomercatoweb , if Napoli beat Juventus, Spalletti’s future could be hanging by a thread. The match represents a major test of whether he can stabilise the team and deliver a response when it matters most. (Photo by Giuseppe Bellini/Getty Images) Napoli Match Could Decide His Future Juventus expect their team to win against Napoli, as they must overcome strong opponents at home. Although Napoli have not been among the best sides in the league in recent months, they remain a dangerous opponent capable of punishing Juventus’ inconsistencies. If Juventus are beaten at home, the club could conclude that there is little reason to retain Spalletti, believing he has failed the test placed before him. The Napoli fixture is therefore about more than three points. It could determine whether Spalletti is given time to rebuild the team or whether Juventus move quickly towards a change in management.

item.title: Alonso admits he had to keep Estevao secret despite pressure from journalists and fans
item.description: Alonso admits he had to keep Estevao secret despite pressure from journalists and fans Xabi Alonso has praised Estevao for his showing against Manchester United today, which really deserved a goal. If you enjoy Talk Chelsea coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. Estevao praised by Alonso for superb game Estevao had a shot. item.title: ‘If that were to happen…’: LeBron James’ potential statue for Lakers receives verdicts from Magic Johnson’s ex-teammate
item.description: Photo by Jim McIsaac/Getty Images Five-time NBA champion Michael Cooper has stated that LeBron James deserves a statue outside Crypto.com Arena as his legendary stint with the Purple and Gold came to an end this offseason. Having left the team with one NBA championship and several major NBA records, including the all-time scoring record, which he broke in 2023 by surpassing another Laker great, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, James definitely had some great moments as a Laker. He was with the team for eight seasons, and although after the championship, there wasn’t much success, King James was committed to the team until his last game. As the icon that he is, there is an expectation among his fans that the Lakers will not only retire his jersey but also build him a statue outside the arena. Michael Cooper explains why LeBron James deserves a statue The Lakers are the third team James has represented in the NBA. However, it is the longest he has ever played for a franchise. While his achievements in Purple and Gold do not compare to the likes of Shaquille O’Neal, Kobe Bryant and Magic Johnson, Cooper believes the King has done enough to be honoured with a statue. “Well, I think that’s going to take time if that were to happen, but anybody that has won a championship in Los Angeles for the Lakers and the player that LeBron James is, deserves a statue out there,” Cooper said in an interview with Brandon “Scoop B” Robinson. Kendrick Perkins also seemed to agree that the four-time champion deserved to be honoured with a statue. In his eight seasons with the team, James averaged 25.9 points, 7.9 assists and 7.7 rebounds. He also made eight All-Star teams and seven All-NBA appearances, showcasing brilliance throughout his stint in LA. Although fans would have liked the player to deliver a few more championships, injuries and roster depth always seemed to hold the team back. While James getting a statue may be something that divides opinions among Lakers fans, Cooper believes that the King definitely deserves to have his jersey retired. “Well, I think when he retires, yeah. LeBron’s going to be… like a lot of people, Wilt Chamberlain’s jersey is retired in different places—Philadelphia and Los Angeles. So, of course. Bron won a championship, so you have to honor him like that,” Cooper said. James’ first game back in LA is set for Christmas Day. It will be interesting to see the kind of reception he gets from Lakers fans. He has been extremely positive about his time in LA, but with fans having mixed reactions to his exit, this is definitely one of the most anticipated Christmas Day games. item.title: Demirovic at the double as Stuttgart see off Leverkusen
item.description: Demirovic at the double as Stuttgart see off Leverkusen Bayer Leverkusen dropped points at the BayArena for the first time this season in the Bundesliga on Saturday, losing 2-4 to VfB Stuttgart, who claimed three much-needed points. The visitors took the lead in the 14th minute, with Ermedin Demirovic firing home the rebound after Mark Flekken had rushed off his line to push the ball away from Bilal El Khannouss. Stuttgart doubled their lead just eight minutes later, as Jamie Leweling pounced on another rebound following a corner. Leverkusen responded in the 28th minute, however, with Patrik Schick heading home from a corner after Dennis Seimen failed to keep out his effort. Both sides came close to adding to the scoreline before half-time, but the crossbar denied Leverkusen's Ibrahim Maza before keeping out Leweling's attempt to grab his second goal of the afternoon. Early in the second half, Stuttgart restored their two-goal lead when El Khannouss unleashed an unstoppable low shot from the edge of the area to put the visitors 3-1 up. Diego Moreira, one of Leverkusen's livelier players in the second half, tried to bring his team back into the game with a fierce shot in the 56th minute, but Seimen denied him with a good save. Instead, Stuttgart went 4-1 up in the 65th minute, as Deniz Undav sent in an inch-perfect pass behind the Leverkusen defence to pick out Ermedin Demirovic, who scored his second goal of the game. Leverkusen refused to give up, though, and Ibrahim Maza gave them a glimmer of hope when he headed in Gutierrez's cross in the 79th minute to make it 2-4. But it wasn't enough for Leverkusen, who suffered their third consecutive defeat against Stuttgart. Sebastian Hoeneß's men will be pleased with the win, which sees them take a big step away from the relegation zone after a disappointing start to the season.

item.title: Imo postpones LG election indefinitely
item.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka OWERRI – The local government election in Imo State scheduled for November 7, 2026, has been postponed indefinitely. The Chairman of the Imo State Independent Electoral Commission, ISIEC, Chief Charles Ejiogu, announced this during a stakeholders meeting in Owerri on Saturday. Ejiogu, though declined to offer any specific reason for the postponement, said the commission was “constrained to announce that the election will not hold.” The chairman stated that the commission will set a new date for the poll within the shortest possible time. Recall that the election was initially fixed for September 26, but the state government said it couldn’t hold due to litigations. “At this juncture, having consulted widely, the Imo State Independent Electoral Commission is constrained to announce that the scheduled Saturday 7th November, 2026 Local Government Council Elections will no longer hold. “Today, the commission will afford you the opportunity to express your considered view points with informed suggestions, as it works towards the new date. “Rest assured that within the shortest possible time, the commission will announce the new date, time table and guidelines. “On behalf of the Imo state Independent Electoral Commission, ISIEC, I hasten to doubly assure all of you that at no time will the commission shirk its constitutional responsibility of conducting a peaceful, transparent and credible Local Government Councils election that will usher in a democratically elected Council Chairmen and Councilors and there will be no two ways to it, as it is a task that must be accomplished,” Ejiogu said. The chairman assured of level playing ground for all the political parties and called for tolerance. “Let me reassure the political parties and their aspirants/candidates that as an Electoral Management Body that the ISIEC will present to all of you a seamless level playing ground for all your Chairmanship and Councillorship candidates that will emerge after the primaries. “In collaboration with the security agencies, the commission is working towards the setting up of Inter Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security, ICCES, that will comprise the Nigeria Police, Nigeria Army, Navy, Air-force DSS, NSCDC and other sister agencies to ensure adequate security before, during and after the elections. We urge IPAC to sign and uphold a PEACE ACCORD, as no one or group of persons will be allowed to subvert the will of the people in the upcoming Council elections,” he submitted. Ejiogu said the meeting was to listen to the stakeholders and seek their empathy and understanding, maintaining that such will collectively build the necessary safeguards for a peaceful, transparent and credible council elections. item.title: Carrick expects to stay as Man Utd coach despite Chelsea defeat
item.description: Michael Carrick said he expects to remain in charge of Manchester United for Tuesday’s Champions League visit of Roma despite a 2-0 defeat at Chelsea that stretched the club’s winless run to nine matches. Carrick was given a stay of execution by the United hierarchy after a 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth last weekend when many expected the axe to fall on the former England midfielder. United were much improved during the first half at Stamford Bridge but paid for a lack of ruthlessness as the visitors wasted a number of chances to take the lead. Morgan Rogers strolled through the heart of the United defence to open the scoring early in the second half. Lisandro Martinez was then shown two quick yellow cards and conceded a penalty, converted by Cole Palmer, to kill off any hope of a United fightback. “Yes,” Carrick told TNT Sports when asked if he expected to remain in charge for the Roma match. “We’ve got to move forward. We’ve got to take the things that we felt worked for us today and take a bit of belief and the confidence from that and a lot of the good things, especially in the first half.” United’s longest winless run for 38 years leaves them just one point above the Premier League relegation zone and at risk of dropping into the bottom three by the end of the weekend. “From being in such a good place in the first half, the two halves of football couldn’t probably be more further apart in some ways,” added Carrick. “I think the way they went about it and played, the quality of football and the way we played in the first half, definitely gives encouragement. We’ve got to take that.” Two defeats in their first three Champions League games have left United 20th in the 36-team table and at risk of missing out on the knockout stages. AFP The post Carrick expects to stay as Man Utd coach despite Chelsea defeat appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Atletico Beat Levante, Move Top Above Barcelona
item.description: Atletico Madrid earned a solid 2-0 win at Levante on Saturday to move provisionally to the top of La Liga before Barcelona host Alaves later on. Diego Simeone’s side climbed a point clear of the Catalan giants, who suffered their first league defeat against rivals Real Madrid last weekend. Goals from Alejandro Grimaldo and Giuliano Simeone in Valencia helped Atletico record a seventh consecutive league win to continue their strong form and put pressure on the reigning champions. “I’m very happy with the team’s work,” Atletico coach Simeone told Movistar. “We’re very far from the end of the season… we’ll keep going game by game.” There was a minute’s silence at the start of the match in memory of the 69 victims of the train crash in the province of Toledo that rocked Spain this week. Levante’s Dani Requena forced Atletico goalkeeper Jan Oblak into an impressive early save. Morten Hjulmand thought he had put Atletico ahead after Alex Baena slipped him in, but a VAR review showed the Dane was offside. Atletico Madrid’s Argentine coach Diego Simeone (centre) reacts during the Spanish league football match between Levante UD and Club Atletico de Madrid at Ciutat de Valencia Stadium in Valencia on October 31, 2026. (Photo by JOSE JORDAN / AFP) Baena, the visitors’ main creative outlet, was involved in the opener. The Spaniard’s pass was poorly defended by Levante and the ball bobbled through to Grimaldo, who lashed high into the net at the near post. Lee Kang-in hit the crossbar early in the second half as Atletico looked to put the game to bed. The coach’s son Giuliano prodded home for Atletico’s second goal after being played in by World Cup winner Baena. Oblak saved superbly from Karl Etta Eyong to stop the hosts fighting their way back into the game. It was Simeone’s 344th La Liga win at the helm of Atletico, matching the club’s record set by Luis Aragonés. “I don’t feel it much as mine, but it belongs to my players, everyone who has been with me for so many years,” said Simeone, who started coaching Atletico in 2011. Atletico host Bayern Munich in the Champions League on Tuesday before welcoming Barca to the Metropolitano stadium next weekend in La Liga. On Sunday, Jose Mourinho’s Real Madrid, third, visit Racing Santander among other fixtures. AFP The post Atletico Beat Levante, Move Top Above Barcelona appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: Zamfara Gov Presents Staff Of Office, Vehicles To 19 Emirs
item.description: Governor Dauda Lawal of Zamfara State has presented staff of office and official vehicles to the 19 emirs in the state as part of efforts to strengthen traditional institutions and enhance grassroots administration. The ceremony, held in Gusau, the state capital, formed part of activities marking the 30th anniversary of Zamfara State. The presentation brought together all 19 emirs, including some who had been appointed before the current administration but were not formally coronated until Governor Lawal assumed office. While addressing the monarchs, the Sultan of Sokoto, Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar III, urged them to always uphold the fear of God in the discharge of their duties. Speaking at the ceremony, Governor Dauda Lawal (right) described the presentation as a significant milestone in the history and governance of the state. He emphasised that traditional rulers must speak the truth without fear or favour, stressing that their loyalty should be to God Almighty. The Sultan also expressed concern over the poor condition of the Sokoto-Gusau Road and called on the relevant authorities to take urgent action to address the situation. Speaking at the ceremony, Lawal described the presentation as a significant milestone in the history and governance of the state. He reaffirmed his administration’s recognition of traditional rulers as critical partners in promoting peace, stability and development. The governor noted that since Zamfara State was created in 1996, traditional institutions had continued to play vital roles in maintaining social order, preserving cultural values and fostering harmonious relationships among communities. He urged the emirs to discharge their responsibilities with fairness, wisdom, integrity and compassion. Governor Lawal particularly called on the traditional rulers to strengthen collaboration with security agencies by providing credible information, mobilising community support and discouraging the protection or concealment of criminal elements, irrespective of their identities or affiliations. He stressed that restoring lasting peace required sustained government efforts, effective security operations and the cooperation and confidence of local communities. The governor also reaffirmed his administration’s commitment to completing the reconstruction and rehabilitation of the remaining royal palaces across the state, noting that the initiative was aimed at strengthening traditional institutions and improving the working environment of traditional rulers. As part of the support, the state government distributed official vehicles to all 19 emirs to facilitate their movement, enhance community engagement, and improve coordination with government institutions. He urged the traditional rulers to ensure proper maintenance and responsible use of the vehicles strictly for official assignments. Google's AI satellite sends a very expensive haiku to Earth
item.description: Google on Friday celebrated receiving a poem from its first experimental orbital AI datacenter satellite. The company's Suncatcher satellite, launched at the start of the month and put into low Earth orbit, has responded to a ground station prompt to "Write a haiku from the perspective of a TPU orbiting Earth, with the wonderful world spinning beneath you." Travis Beals, senior director of Google's interdisciplinary Paradigms of Intelligence research team, said that with Suncatcher's host and TPU trays powered up and machine learning tests completed, the onboard Gemma 4 model achieved its "Hello World" milestone by sending an inference response from orbit. "During a ground-station pass, we uplinked our first prompt to our onboard Gemma 4 open model, asking it to generate a haiku about being in space," wrote Beals in a blog post . And as the satellite passed over Svalbard, Norway, the orbiting AI model responded over the downlink: Blue marble below, Data streams in silent grace, Starlight feeds my core. ✨ Those roughly 20 tokens would cost about $0.000012 if generated through the Google Cloud API, based on Gemma 4 26B's pricing of $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens, excluding input costs. Add in a satellite weighing perhaps 500 kg, based on the mass of SpaceX's Starlink satellites, and a retail launch price of around $7,000 per kg, and you have a very expensive haiku. According to Google's calculations , if the cost of getting a satellite into low Earth orbit can be brought down to $200/kg, the launch cost amortized over the satellite's useful life (~$810–7,500/kW/year) could be comparable to current electricity spending for terrestrial datacenters in the US (~$570–3,000/kW/year). Google predicts that SpaceX could achieve that by 2035, more or less, and considers it strategically beneficial to prototype well in advance of that actually happening. After the haiku, Beals said, "we tested space-themed limericks and telemetry prompts reporting the technical status of the payload systems." Next up: tests for evaluating how TPUs perform under thermal stress and radiation. Google has already done some laboratory testing of its Trillium Cloud TPU and AMD host server to see how well they can withstand a 67 MeV proton beam. The system's high-bandwidth memory shows the most sensitivity in terms of the total ionizing dose – it exhibits irregularities after a cumulative dose of 2 krad(Si), which is about 3× Google's minimum requirement for TID survival of 750 rad(Si). "For typical transformer workloads, the observed SDC [silent data corruption] rate of approximately one event/17 rad, at an estimated orbital dose of 150 rad(Si)/year, translates to a very low failure probability on the order of 1 per 3 million inferences, assuming 1 inference per second," Google researchers said in a paper published earlier this month. item.title: Immigration orders officers to eliminate delays, report cyber threats
item.description: By Omeiza Ajayi As part of measures to ensure stronger customer service and tighter digital security, Comptroller General of Nigeria Immigration Service NIS, Kemi Nanna Nandap, has directed personnel to eliminate unnecessary delays in service delivery and to promptly report suspected cyber threats. Service Public Relations Officer, DCI Akinsola Akinlabi said Nandap gave the charge at two separate events in Abuja – the 2026 International Customer Service Week and the Service’s 2026 Cybersecurity Awareness Seminar. Speaking at the closing of the Customer Service Week, which ran from Wednesday, October 28, to Friday, October 30, under the theme “Going the Extra Mile – Creating a Lasting Smile,” Nandap urged officers to make excellent customer service part of the Service’s daily operations. She stressed professionalism, timely service delivery, prompt complaints resolutions and respectful treatment of customers. The Comptroller General charged officers to uphold integrity, eliminate unnecessary delays and make customer satisfaction a key performance benchmark. She also reaffirmed ongoing reforms to improve customer satisfaction and what the Service calls Hostmanship. The Head of Operations at the Service Compact with all Nigerians (SERVICOM) unit in the Presidency, Mrs Ngozi Akinbodewa, commended the Service for evolving its SERVICOM Unit. She said this year’s Customer Service Week marked a critical step towards sustaining citizen-focused service delivery in line with global best practices. Akinbodewa added that the international event offered an opportunity to recognise employees who go the extra mile in exceeding expectations and meeting customer needs. The Special Assistant to the Comptroller-General of Immigration Service on SERVICOM, DCI A.M. Abubakar, highlighted the importance of accountability, responsiveness and adherence to service standards. He urged officers to continually improve their conduct and prioritise customer satisfaction in the discharge of their duties. At the Cybersecurity Awareness Seminar, Nandap, who was represented by the Deputy Comptroller General, Finance and Accounts, DCG S.B. Daura, told officers that cybersecurity is a collective responsibility. She urged them to remain vigilant, observe established security protocols and promptly report suspected threats. She also called for continuous capacity building, institutional collaboration and proactive measures to address emerging cyber threats, before declaring the seminar open. Resource persons from the Department of State Services (DSS), the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC), the Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) and the National Information Technology Development Agency (NITDA) made technical presentations. item.title: Our part of Mbappe, China issue over – Real Madrid’s Mourinho
item.description: Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho said Saturday the club’s involvement in the controversy over Kylian Mbappe’s comments about an internet meme about himself and former Chinese leader Mao Zedong was over, after both the player and club apologised. Mbappe’s remarks sparked a backlash in China, with Real Madrid, the France forward and La Liga all issuing apologies, but Chinese state television nevertheless pulled Spanish football from its schedules. In a clip from an interview with French show “The Bridge” which has since been taken down, Mbappe had said he was amused by an internet meme showing his face photoshopped onto “some guy, think he’s a Chinese dictator”, an apparent reference to Mao. Mourinho said both Mbappe and 15-time European champions Real Madrid “had the class” to issue swift apologies and believes there is nothing more for them to do. “I’ve seen a lot of responsibility from a club which, at this level, is a club of great class, and as far as we’re concerned, that’s it, we’ve done our part, there’s nothing more for us to do,” Mourinho told reporters. Mocking former leader Mao — blamed by historians for millions of deaths — is taboo in China, and the 27-year-old’s remarks saw him become the latest foreign sports figure to anger Beijing. “With this situation involving China, these are the dangers of today’s world, where many times the best thing you can do is keep your mouth shut, because there’s danger in so many things you say or comment on,” said Mourinho. Mbappe has endured a difficult week, after he finished second behind Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane in Monday’s Ballon d’Or ceremony. Mourinho praised Mbappe’s reaction after England international Kane was named the world’s best player. “Kylian is very intelligent, very mature, with a very high level of self-esteem,” said Mourinho. “At the same time, he shows real class in the way he’s interpreted the Ballon d’Or going to Harry. In him I’ve only seen and felt class and respect. “One thing is knowing you’re the best, and another is having respect for those who have also done a lot to win a trophy. From him I only see class.” Mourinho said midfielder Jude Bellingham coming in 11th in the voting left him with his “mouth open”, implying the Englishman should have finished far higher. However, the veteran Portuguese coach, who worked with Kane at Tottenham between 2019 and 2021, said he was happy for the Bayern hitman. “I had the privilege of working with Harry, he’s a great player and a great professional and a great person,” added Mourinho. “Inside the frustration that my player (Mbappe) didn’t win, well, I have to be honest and say I’m very happy for Harry, a player and a boy who deserves it.” The post Our part of Mbappe, China issue over – Real Madrid’s Mourinho appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.description: Michael Carrick’s stay as Manchester United boss may not last long after his team was caught flat-footed in a 2-0 Premier League loss at Chelsea on Saturday. The visitors wasted a string of chances to take the lead at Stamford Bridge before Morgan Rogers waltzed through the heart of the United defence to open the scoring on 50 minutes. Chelsea’s English midfielder Morgan Rogers celebrates after scoring the opening goal of the English Premier League football match between Chelsea and Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in London on October 31, 2026. (Photo by Glyn KIRK / AFP) Lisandro Martinez then ruined any chance of a revival from Carrick’s men with two quickfire yellow cards, the second of which also conceded a penalty converted by Cole Palmer. Winless in nine games, defeat leaves the 20-time English champions still just one point above the relegation zone and in danger of ending the weekend in the bottom three. Many expected Carrick to be axed following last weekend’s 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth. Manchester United’s English head coach Michael Carrick reacts on the touchline during the English Premier League football match between Chelsea and Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in London on October 31, 2026. (Photo by Glyn KIRK / AFP) The former United midfielder was instead given the chance to turn his side’s fortunes around and will lament a lack of ruthlessness during the first half. Carrick recalled captain Bruno Fernandes after he was left out last weekend in the wake of criticising his manager’s tactics during a 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League. Fernandes should have marked his return with the opener when he blazed over from Bryan Mbeumo’s inviting cross. Chelsea’s English midfielder Morgan Rogers (L) vies with Manchester United’s Portuguese midfielder Bruno Fernandes (R) during the English Premier League football match between Chelsea and Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in London on October 31, 2026. (Photo by Glyn KIRK / AFP) The roles were reversed when Mbeumo could not stretch to meet Fernandes’s delivery at the back post before Amad Diallo was twice denied by Chelsea’s stand-in goalkeeper Mike Penders. United did finally get the ball in the net when Matheus Cunha turned in Harry Maguire’s header from a corner, but the Brazilian had strayed just offside. Carrick could not hide his frustration in a half-time interview to broadcasters, and his mood soured further with a disastrous start to the second period. English referee Peter Bankes shows a second yellow card to Manchester United’s Argentinian defender Lisandro Martinez (2nd-right) during the English Premier League football match between Chelsea and Manchester United at Stamford Bridge in London on October 31, 2026.
